publication.scope: Frozen b388330 ordinary AR compatibility path versus final JetSpec serving; NOT pristine upstream FlashAttention AR.
publication.output_cap_scale_note: 128/512 label the unchanged mixed cap scale O,O,O/2,O/4 cyclically, not uniform outputs for c4/c8.
publication.contribution_attribution: This two-arm benchmark measures the combined speculative-decoding and serving/system implementation effect; it does not identify separate percentage shares.
publication.gap_reporting: Median-of-run p95 and median-of-run max retained; extra all_sample_max_per_request_delivery_gap_s is the true worst observed max across all three runs.
publication.memory_reporting: PyTorch allocator peak allocated/reserved (max across trials), not whole-device/NVML peak.
publication.summary_sample_scope: Every timed sample is included. Raw request delivery events/token IDs remain in the full raw artifact; this publication includes full per-run statistics but omits large request/event arrays.

summary.latency_aggregation: Each sample first computes request p50/p95/max; summary takes the median of the corresponding sample statistic. No pooled-p95 or median-request-p95 substitution.
summary.throughput: Actual emitted output token count / synchronized sample wall time; ratio of mode medians, not best samples.
summary.delivery_tpot: (last nonempty delivery time - first nonempty delivery time)/(output token count - 1); this is burst-delivery TPOT, NOT internal per-token ITL.
summary.batch_gaps: Successive unique step timestamps with at least one nonempty token event, not duplicated across requests. Separate per-request gap statistics coalesce multiple deltas delivered in the same step; raw delivery_events preserve every original delta.
summary.output_blocks: Sum of trimmed effective verification output_block lengths, excluding initial prefill anchors; denominators are packed forward calls and request-verification participations respectively.
